description: Lizzy and Luke's plan to have a child together is transformed overnight when Luke marries Prudence just as Lizzy learns she is pregnant. The new three-person household tries to define family on the fly while jealousy, dating, immigration trouble and wildly different ideas about domestic life keep disrupting any chance of normality.

s01e01.description: Best friends Lizzy and Luke finally succeed in conceiving a child together, only for Luke to announce that he has unexpectedly married Prudence, forcing all three to rethink the family they thought they were creating.

s01e02.description: Prudence moves into the apartment and pushes Lizzy to clear away reminders of an old relationship, while Luke discovers that adjusting to his new wife's habits is rather less romantic than marrying her was.

s01e03.description: Lizzy gets help approaching a woman she likes and lands a coveted obstetric appointment, while Prudence begins to admit that Lizzy's pregnancy is making her feel excluded from Luke's new family.

s01e04.description: Prudence decides the household has become too predictable and challenges Luke and Lizzy to be more adventurous, prompting Luke to attempt skydiving with results considerably less elegant than advertised.

s01e05.description: A Las Vegas trip reveals that Luke and Prudence's wedding was not legally valid, sending Lizzy into emergency wedding-planner mode before another surprise from Prudence's life in England complicates matters further.

s01e06.description: A secret from Prudence's past sends Luke disappearing just as her immigration status becomes precarious, leaving Lizzy to hold the household together and devise an unusually bold solution.
